entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Unexpected order of custom modifiers read from metadata #79344
  • "Make method synchronous" fix should not be provided for an interface implementing method #79342
    Backlog
  • IDE0007 not reported when resolved type is Span<T> #79337
  • C# compiler crashes when using "switch" block #79336

Closed

  • CSharpUseNullPropagationCodeFixProvider for IDE0031 in SyntaxEditor fails with "GetCurrentNode returned null" on Windows and macOS but works on Linux #79338
  • Extensions: public API for extension syntax in CREF #78738
    Next
  • Filters in CodeLens results for references #39822
    Backlog
  • Unexpected behavior of property increment when receiver is a generic type parameter substituted with a reference type #79268

Created

  • Adds EqualityComparer<T>.Create polyfill #79345
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Update to xunit.runner.visualstudio 3.1.1 #79343
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Cleanup ProjectSystemProjectCreationInfo #79341
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix code gen for some compound assignment scenarios involving extension properties. #79339
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Improve compiler server/client logging #79335
    Area-Compilers

Merged

    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Fix code gen for some increment/compound assignment scenarios involving constrained calls. #79293
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Set RoslynCompilerType=Custom in all toolset package flavors #79327
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Extensions: extension marker type name #79308

  • Project options #79239

  • WIP: Move to Resx MVP #79297
